# KUNETT Hardware

> KUNETT Hardware (Harikrushna Enterprise) is an Indian manufacturer of solid aerospace-grade 6063-T5 virgin aluminium architectural handles, continuous handle profiles (continuous profile handles), concealed wardrobe counsil handles, and cabinet knobs, located in Rajkot, Gujarat.

## Core Products
- [Solid Aluminium Handles](https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-handles.html): Solid extruded virgin aluminium cabinet and wardrobe pull handles, CNC VMC machined, sizes 96mm to 1200mm.
- [Aluminium Handle Profiles](https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-handle-profile.html): Continuous edge-mounted profile handles and Gola G-profiles, blade-cut lengths up to 3 meters (10 feet).
- [Concealed Wardrobe Counsil Handles](https://kunetthardware.com/wardrobe-counsil-handles.html): Deep-recess flush concealed handles for full-height 7ft to 9ft wardrobe panels.
- [Sliding Wardrobe Handles](https://kunetthardware.com/sliding-wardrobe-handles.html): Zero-clearance flush sliding door handles preventing shutter collisions.
- [Solid Aluminium Cabinet Knobs](https://kunetthardware.com/cabinet-knobs.html): Minimalist solid geometric knobs for vanities, bedside tables, and dressers.

## Company
- [About Us](https://kunetthardware.com/about.html): Company history of Harikrushna Enterprise, founder Sanjay Patel, and 10+ years of hardware engineering in Rajkot, Gujarat.
- [Manufacturing Process](https://kunetthardware.com/our-process.html): Tour our 5-axis CNC VMC milling, extrusion, and 15-micron electrochemical anodizing facility.
- [Contact Factory](https://kunetthardware.com/contact.html): Factory address at Shop No. 5 & 6, Street No. 2, Maruti Industries, Rolex Rd, Kotharia, Rajkot, with direct phone and WhatsApp inquiry.
- [Terms of Service](https://kunetthardware.com/terms.html): B2B wholesale ordering terms, minimum order quantities, pan-India logistics, and 15-micron anodizing warranty.

## Architectural Journal & Sourcing Guides
- [Architecture & Sourcing Journal](https://kunetthardware.com/blog.html): Central hub for architectural hardware comparisons, industrial cluster reports, and technical sourcing guides.
- [Top 10 Aluminium Handle Manufacturers in Rajkot](https://kunetthardware.com/top-10-aluminium-handle-manufacturers-in-rajkot.html): 2026 wholesale buyer guide and Rajkot hardware industrial cluster overview (Atika, Aji GIDC, Metoda).
- [Aluminium Profile Handles for Modular Furniture](https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-profile-handles-modern-modular-furniture.html): Engineering guide to continuous edge-mounted profiles for handle-less modular kitchens and wardrobes.
- [Aluminium vs Stainless Steel Handles Comparison](https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-vs-steel-handles-for-new-home.html): Technical comparison of 6063-T5 virgin alloy vs steel on corrosion, weight, tactile warmth, and anodized finishes.
- [How to Choose Aluminium Handles for Wardrobes](https://kunetthardware.com/how-to-choose-aluminium-handle-for-wardrobe.html): Sizing, weight, clearance, and finish matching guide for full-height sliding and swing wardrobe doors.
